description:
Advances: ancora.parsing
Ready-for: investigate

Symptom: with zoi 0.19.0 resolved, every ancora task that parses specs crashes. `mix spec.check` on Argos ended with `** (Mix) spec_parse worker failed for .spec/specs/access-obo-tokens.spec.md: key :prefix_items not found in: %{meta: %{...}}` and a stack through `Zoi.Inspect.build/3`.

Evidence: ancora's mix.exs requires `{:zoi, "~> 0.17"}`, which admits every 0.x release from 0.17.0. ancora's own mix.lock pins zoi 0.18.7, and so does Argos's. Switching Argos's ancora dep from Hex to a path dep unlocked ancora's children, `mix deps.get` resolved zoi 0.19.0 (and decimal 3.2.0), and the gate crashed on the first spec. Pinning zoi 0.18.7 back made it pass. Seen 2026-11-13 while measuring ancora-z19.

Why now: Argos and Atlas pin `{:ancora, "~> 1.3.0"}` and lock zoi 0.18.7. Their next `mix deps.update --all`, or any update that unlocks zoi, pulls 0.19 and breaks Spec Check in CI. Either cap the requirement below 0.19 in a 1.3.x release or make ancora's schemas work on 0.19.
title: zoi 0.19.0 breaks spec parsing, and the ~> 0.17 requirement admits it
